purpose: Make the 13-question governed identity/provenance spine an actual consequential execution lifecycle without creating a second authority or event store.
invariants: Identity never creates or expands authority.
Canonical authority remains the existing authority registry and governance kernel.
Consequential execution requires the complete governed identity envelope.
The exact identity fingerprint and identity/action binding are carried into the execution credential.
The observed result is evidence, not authority.
Smart Ledger receipt creation occurs only after consequential authorization verification and an observed completed execution result.
Identity and Smart Ledger binding integrity are validated before canonical Activity publication.
Canonical Activity is the execution projection; no second canonical execution event store is introduced.
PIS remains the existing canonical Smart Note intelligence projection.
